confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are medium-confidence. They rest on search snippets from travel guides, a 2026 consumer-group espresso survey, and a Rome drinks guide, not on an official Siena menu survey. Cappuccino, beer and cocktail are the least certain. The cocktail and wine_glass values use Rome bar prices and the local beer-to-wine relationship because direct Siena data was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against live listings or current booking pages. July is peak season and includes the Palio, so room rates may be higher than shown. The fx observation came from search-result text dated 2026-03-20; I did not open the RBA page and cannot confirm it is the latest observation as of 2026-10-16, so it may be stale. The EUR-to-USD basis used for the USD anchors (about 1.17) is an assumption and was not searched.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Italian restaurant and bar price levels for a tourist-heavy Tuscan hill town, cross-checked against Rome bar prices and regional espresso price data. Accommodation is compared with mid-sized Tuscan tourist towns in peak season.
